Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression is redundant because 古代 already refers to a time period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 医：医生，医 is not normally used alone for the occupation in this context; 医生 means “doctor.” [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看：看到，看到 is needed when the meaning is successfully seeing someone, rather than simply directing one’s eyes toward them. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别人 refers to other people in general; 别的 is used to distinguish something from a specific one already under discussion. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，株 is an appropriate measure word for an individual plant; 个 is too generic here. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农三个月走去：他三个月走去，Use a pronoun because 神农 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other character competes as the referent. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 三个月走去，找到有植物的地方：走了三个月，找到了有植物的地方，Both actions are completed: 了 follows 走 before its duration phrase, and 找到了 marks the completed result of finding the place. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代已经表示时间，古代的时候按老师的规则重复，改为在古代正确。
医不能在这里单独表示职业，医生是正确的职业名称。
这里表示看见病人，需要结果补语，看到正确。
别的人不符合老师对别人/别的的规定，别人是可用的改法。
个可以作植物的通用量词，株更具体但不是必须改正的错误。
按老师的指代规则，刚提到神农时应使用他，但改后仍有三个月走去的语法问题。
走了三个月和找到了都正确标记了已完成的动作。
